definitions.reappearance: first start of >=3 consecutive frames with visibility >= 0.5 after the event
definitions.episode: severe events with the same reappearance frame are merged
definitions.phases: before: <=60 frames before episode start (frame 0 excluded); during: start..reappearance-1; after: reappearance..last
definitions.recovery: first start at/after reappearance of >=5 consecutive frames with error <= 0.1 diameter
